```artifact
GUI Event Graphs Test Suite for U02_Alarms

1. Alarm for Low Pressure on Air Line
   - Start with normal air line pressure
   - Simulate blockage of air line
   - Verify HIGH severity alarm trigger
2. Alarm for Low Pressure on O2 Line
   - Start with normal O2 line pressure
   - Simulate blockage of O2 line
   - Verify HIGH severity alarm trigger
3. Alarm for Inspiratory Pressure Drop
   - Start with normal inspiratory pressure
   - Simulate drop below -4cm H2O
   - Verify HIGH severity alarm trigger
4. Alarm for GUI Unresponsiveness
   - Start with GUI responsive
   - Simulate GUI unresponsiveness for 1/2 of apnea time
   - Verify HIGH severity alarm trigger
5. Alarm for Controller Unresponsiveness
   - Start with Controller responsive
   - Simulate Controller unresponsiveness for 1/2 of apnea time
   - Verify HIGH severity alarm trigger
6. Overpressure Alarm on GUI
   - Start with normal pressure
   - Simulate overpressure above 60 cmH2O
   - Verify alarm trigger
7. Overpressure Alarm on Controller
   - Start with normal pressure
   - Simulate overpressure above 60 cmH2O
   - Verify alarm trigger

```
